response.overview: Puppet Playhouse is set in a fictional city named Ashport in November of 1963. In this city and places around it, reality has began to warp and change. Some people have began to morph, limbs growing longer or shorter, eyes growing too big, and other parts of their body change. Buildings disappear as if they were never there, and some appear as from thin air. In this city, a factory has began to create toys that come to life, and they send the failed ones, (normal toys) down to a big toy shop in Ashport. But sometimes, living toys slip through the cracks and end up in the storage units of the toy shop.  The story follows Henry, a toy who awoke in the shop with no memory of his life before. All he can remember is the basic things, how to talk, his first name. The first film entry follows him searching the city, and learning about the vile truth of what really happens in the factory.
response.title: Puppet Playhouse
